title: Combinatorial CAR T-cell Circuit Design using Single- and Multi-Objective Local Search
summary: CAR T-cell circuit design enables targeting tumour cells while keeping healthy cells unaffected to a cancer treatment. Designing CAR T-cell circuits that maximize the number of tumour cells eliminated (called efficacy) while meeting the safety constraint of keeping a large number of healthy cells unaffected is a challenging task. We provide a new multistart local search approach for this problem and show that it outperforms the current SOTA approach on a single-cell cancer atlas.
